_doc: Fixtures + thresholds for .harmony/probe-image-load.sh (s-rta-0928 renderleft R1). Rows and calibration: the docstring of .harmony/probe-image-load.py. Fixture images are generated per run into <out>/media (numpy seed 928, PIL compress_level 1): every path is new to the app instance.
_peakMaxMs: one 60 Hz frame period: a callback under it cannot drop a frame
_boxTol: dbox(X, Y): both arrays box-averaged in 16x16 blocks, then mean |diff| over RGB (0..255)
_fixtureMinD: a fixture pair (warm picture vs cold picture) must differ by at least this much, or the row proves nothing
_i2mFirstMaxP: C1 (Harmony adoption): the first frame that answers a capture after a 1 s dissolve onto a cold 4K image has dissolve progress <= this (about 4 frames at 60 Hz; without the pause it is the decode time / 1 s)
